note: Volume UUIDs of the 22H374 volume set already written to the device (run 43581151943), uppercase as diskutil and IOMedia print them. Source: read from the APFS volume headers. A run that rebuilds the userdata image overwrites this file from its own volume-layout artifact; it is committed so a boot-side-only rebuild still compiles the kernel with the UUIDs the flashed volumes actually carry.
